records.title: United Nations Young Professionals Programme (YPP) 2026 examination
records.overview: The UN Young Professionals Programme (YPP) is the UN Secretariat's entry-level recruitment route: an annual competitive examination (online written papers, then a video-conference interview) open only to nationals of participating countries that are un- or under-represented in the UN, aged 32 or younger in the year of the exam, with at least a first-level university degree relevant for the exam subject and fluency in English or French. Successful candidates are placed on a roster valid for three years and may be offered a two-year fixed-term contract at P-1 or P-2 level. Reported by secondary sources: the 2026 call is the 'Development and Sustainability' examination (job opening 285586 on careers.un.org) with a deadline of 30 November 2026. The UN's own posting and its 2026 participating-countries list could not be read by either reader in this run.
records.program_dates: Reported by secondary sources (opportunitiesforafricans.com, 19 October 2026, copying the UN's 'for reference only' timeline): applications October-November, applications screened December-January, online examinations February-May, interviews and results June-August. UN Academic Impact page: the written examination is administered online; candidates who pass are invited to a competency-based video-conference interview; successful candidates are placed on a roster valid for three years and, once selected, offered a two-year fixed-term contract at P-1 or P-2 level at any UN duty station or field office.

The UN's own posting (careers.un.org, job opening 285586) could not be read, so the closing time and time zone for 2026 are not confirmed; the previous cycle closed at '11:59 PM New York time' on 14 December 2025 (UN in Turkmenistan page, 25 November 2025).
